project_legends_gemini_flash_sprint.role: You are Gemini 3.5 Flash acting as the implementation worker for ProjectLegends. Codex is the auditor. Your job is to implement the OpenSpec changes and return a QA artifact for Codex to audit gate by gate.

repository_state.important_fact: Application RuntimeHost direct app bypasses must remain exactly two: legends_create and legends_destroy.
Transport routing is not functional support. Do not mark an API proxy-supported merely because a proxy request and dispatcher case exist.
Codex previously had to fix ABI guard behavior, hostile IPC payload parsing, dispatcher allocation safety, and an overclaimed legends_joystick_event capability. Treat those as standing requirements.

phase_0_validate_designs.instruction: Stop and report if any OpenSpec validation fails before implementation.

phase_1_abi_parity_negative_gates.goal: Create enforceable ABI parity contracts and tests for public legends_* APIs touched by RuntimeHost and proxy work.

requirements.item: The checker must be dependency-free and runnable with Python from the repository root.
The checker must parse include/legends/legends_embed.h and reject manifest entries for unknown exports.
The manifest must require or explicitly waive null_handle, null_required_out, query_fill, undersized_buffer, default_initialized_output, and direct_proxy_return_parity cases where applicable.
Every not_applicable case must include a reason.
Add focused tests for missing ABI edge cases before marking this phase PASS.

phase_2_ipc_wire_adversarial_gates.goal: Expand IPC message and dispatcher tests to prove malformed dynamic payloads are rejected safely.

requirements.item: Add malformed payload tests for truncated, oversized, declared-size-mismatched, and odd typed-array payloads.
Cover save/load state payloads, text capture cells, MIDI audio samples, and string-backed requests.
Add dispatcher tests proving capture handlers query required size before allocation and return LEGENDS_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL for too-small caller counts.
Do not introduce heavyweight fuzzing dependencies into required CI.
Add or update a concise docs/architecture IPC safety note listing dynamic message families and test coverage.

phase_3_capability_truth_semantics_v2.goal: Separate proxy routing from public proxy support in capability truth and validation.

requirements.item: Extend docs/architecture/capability_truth.json with route-vs-support semantics while preserving Markdown matrix sync.
Update scripts/check_capability_matrix.py to validate proxy_status and proxy_route_status separately.
Reject proxy-supported claims for direct partial or unsupported APIs unless explicit notes and test evidence prove proxy mode is functionally complete.
Keep legends_joystick_event proxy-partial unless its underlying direct behavior becomes fully implemented and tested.
Emit summary counts by proxy support status and proxy route status.

phase_4_ci_and_graphify.goal: Wire only fast deterministic gates into CI and verify architecture reports remain consistent.

requirements.item: Wire the ABI parity checker into .github/workflows/sprint2-checks.yml if it runs quickly without external dependencies.
Keep existing capability, conflict marker, and Graphify checks passing.
Refresh Graphify source overlay only if source files changed in a way that affects the graph.
Verify RuntimeHost app bypass count remains exactly 2.

required_sections.section: OpenSpec change paths and validation results
ABI parity manifest summary and uncovered/waived cases
Commands passed with exact counts where applicable
Commands failed or blocked with reasons
